title: No More Import Errors: Constrained Decoding for Guaranteed Valid Imports in LLM-Generated Tests
summary: The study identifies import streaks as a failure mode of greedy constrained decoding and tests CBDL, which reduces invalid imports and improves the fraction of correct generated tests in the reported Python/Java tasks.
